tool: codex exec -m gpt-5.6-sol, $imagegen, refs: checkout.draft render + start screen
style: Use case: ui-mockup. A full-page desktop website comp, 1600px wide browser viewport, for draftably, a developer tool: a text language (.draft files) and a local CLI that turn plain text into clean, auto-laid-out architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams and flows. Audience: software engineers and AI-agent users. Mood: calm, precise, editorial, confident; dense but uncluttered, like Linear or Stripe docs, not a playful startup page. Flat UI, 1px hairline borders, small 6px radii, no glassmorphism, no gradients except none, no drop shadows beyond a faint 1px. Typography: Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for code. Palette, exact hex only: page background #f5f6f9, panel #fbfbfd, ink #15171f, muted ink #5b6070, hairline #e3e6ec, strong line #c9cfda, accent violet #6650d9, accent soft #efebfd, example amber #c7861f. Diagrams inside the comp must look like image 1 (the real draftably renderer: rounded rectangles in muted blue/green/purple fills, soft tinted group containers with small caps titles, orthogonal connectors with small labels). Image 2 shows the existing app chrome and type for reference only. All visible text must be real, legible English; no lorem ipsum, no gibberish. The product name is spelled exactly "draftably".
